review:
A cartel-movie slot with an extra reel above the grid and another below it. Each lands just one symbol per spin, but those symbols mess with the main reels – spawning symbols, turning them wild, blowing them up, multiplying them, or even getting them 'arrested'.

Two badge scatters can trigger one of three free spins types, where the extra reels open cell by cell. One of the most inventive games BGaming has made. 10,000x max, 96.67% RTP, no published volatility. Free spins about once every 277 spins.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
